ops.title: Keep failure observations from status and PR card reads
ops.description: Owner: rerun-reads-pending implementation owner. Evidence: plugins/long-running/lib/drive/cli.py:616 updates only the temporary status overlay; status at lines 666-672 never saves it. plugins/long-running/lib/drive/card.py:186 only consults stored failure names and never records newly observed failures. If either path alone observes a failure between watch polls, a subsequent missing-rerun context reports pass. Next: retain per-head failure observations from both read adapters in shared history.

ops.text: A status read that sees failure followed by a fresh status read with that context absent reports pending, without an intervening watch read.
A card read that sees failure followed by a redraw with that context absent reports pending, without an intervening watch read.
Failure history remains tied to the observed head and resets after a head change.
